question: Which of the following was included as an official Olympic sport in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Breakdancing.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Breakdancing**__

 __
 
• It is an athletic style of street dance originating from the African American and Puerto Rican communities in the US.
 
• IT is typically set to songs containing drum breaks, especially in hip-hop, funk, soul music, and breakbeat music.
 
• A practitioner of this dance is called a b-boy, b-girl, breakdancer, or breaker.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Olympic 2020:**__

 
 
• The 2020 summer Olympics is an international sports event that will be held from 23 July to 8 August 2021, in the city of Tokyo, Japan. As the name suggests, this summer Olympics were originally intended to be held from 24 July to 9 August 2020, but due to the ongoing Covid-19 Pandemic, Tokyo 2020 Olympics was postponed.
 
• The name Tokyo 2020' is not changed to Tokyo 2021' because of marketing and branding reasons.
 
• This is also the first time in history when an Olympic games event is postponed instead of being cancelled.
 
• The motto of summer Olympic 2020 is Faster, Higher, Stronger Together. Hence, Statement 1 is not correct.
 
• Six new sports are added at the Tokyo summer Olympics 2020 baseball, softball, karate, skateboarding, sport climbing, and surfing. 
 
• Tokyo has hosted the Summer Olympic Games in 1964 thereby becoming the first Asian city to host Summer Olympics twice.
 
• **India won 7 medals (1 Gold, 2 Silver, 4 Bronze) in Tokyo Olympics 2020.**
 
 
 
• **​Upcoming Olympic(2024) will be held in Paris.**
